title: rosa rubiginosa var. braunii
intro: Rosa rubiginosa var. braunii, commonly known as Alpine Rose, is a fragrant, pink-flowering shrub native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including stress, anxiety, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa rubiginosa var. braunii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
